description: This PHP source file defines the ApplyLeaveController class within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The controller manages the leave application process, preparing data such as work shift times for the leave application UI component.

classes.name: ApplyLeaveController
classes.description: Controller class for handling leave application, extending AbstractVueController and incorporating traits for authentication, date/time helper, and work schedule services. It prepares the work shift data for the front end component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component with work shift start and end times formatted as time strings, for rendering the leave application form.
